meta.name: debugging-dbt-errors
meta.description:
Debugs and fixes dbt errors systematically. Use when working with dbt errors for:
(1) Task mentions "fix", "error", "broken", "failing", "debug", "wrong", or "not working"
(2) Compilation Error, Database Error, or test failures occur
(3) Model produces incorrect output or unexpected results
(4) Need to troubleshoot why a dbt command failed
Reads full error, checks upstream first, runs dbt build (not just compile) to verify fix.

copy.tagline: 系统排查并修复 dbt 模型错误
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到 dbt 编译或运行错误需要快速定位修复
copy.tagline_en: Systematically debug and fix dbt model errors
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently encounter dbt compilation or runtime errors and need quick fixes

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 当遇到 dbt 错误时，Claude 会读取完整错误信息，先检查上游模型，然后修复问题，并强制运行 `dbt build` 验证修复，最后检查数据正确性和下游影响。
howto.when: 当任务提到“修复”、“错误”、“损坏”、“失败”、“调试”、“错误”或“不工作”，或出现编译错误、数据库错误、测试失败，或模型输出不正确时触发。

say.text: 帮我修复这个 dbt 编译错误
say.note: Claude 会读取错误并开始排查

say.text: 我的 dbt 模型输出不对，帮我看看
say.note: Claude 会检查数据并分析原因

say.text: dbt 测试失败了，帮我调试
say.note: Claude 会运行测试并修复问题

howto.what_en: When encountering a dbt error, Claude reads the full error, checks upstream models first, applies a fix, and always runs `dbt build` to verify. It then checks data correctness and downstream impact.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the task mentions "fix", "error", "broken", "failing", "debug", "wrong", or "not working", or when compilation errors, database errors, test failures occur, or model output is incorrect.

say_en.note: Claude reads the error and starts debugging

say_en.text: My dbt model output is wrong, help me check
say_en.note: Claude inspects data and analyzes the issue

say_en.text: dbt test failed, help me debug
say_en.note: Claude runs tests and fixes the problem
